# Payment Method Events

Relays payment method requests and provides an account-transfer settlement action inside the executing Payment Instruction. On initialization it emits Customer Payment Session Requested when `/paymentDetails/method` equals `myos-customer`, or Account Payment Instruction Created otherwise. A Payment Requested event is relayed as MyOS Execution Requested with the method, triggering request and payment details. These announcements ask the integration to act.

When configured for a fixed account transfer, `validateAccountTransfer` checks the payout profile against the frozen net amount and payee. It permits only full-amount secure, capture and void requests with their prescribed payout request identities. It rejects changes to payee, amount or transaction details and disallows reversals for this profile.

`confirmAccountSettlement` uses the caller allowed by the configured connection. It requires an accepted instruction with a transaction and nonempty debit and transfer references. It records a report at `/accountSettlement` with the frozen gross, fee and net amounts, currency and instruction and transaction identities. An exact retry is a duplicate and a conflicting report fails. A new report emits Account Settlement Confirmed. The separate Payment Instruction protocol records confirmed transfer effects.
